pack.title: DSB-SC balanced modulator and synchronous detector

aim.en: Prepare to connect, observe and explain DSB-SC generation and coherent recovery on a physical trainer.
aim.or: ପ୍ରକୃତ trainer ରେ DSB-SC generation ଓ coherent recovery ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ହୁଅନ୍ତୁ।

description.en: A schematic reconstruction of the modulator and receiver, not a manufacturer panel replica.
description.or: ଏହା modulator ଓ receiver ର ଶିକ୍ଷଣ ମଡେଲ୍।

description.en: Carrier source shared with the synchronous receiver.
description.or: ଏହି carrier କୁ modulator ଓ receiver ରେ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରାଯାଏ।

description.en: Apply the message to this input.
Apply the carrier to this input.
Balanced-modulator output; inspect suppression after null adjustment.
description.or: null adjustment ପରେ ଏଠାରେ DSB-SC signal ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ।

description.en: Input for the transmitted DSB-SC signal.
A coherent carrier reference is required for recovery.
description.or: message ପାଇବା ପାଇଁ coherent carrier reference ଦରକାର।

description.en: Receiver output after the low-pass section.
Probe the specified signal output and follow the approved common-reference arrangement.
description.or: ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ signal output ରେ probe ଯୋଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

description.en: Virtual power switch; physical power checks remain with the instructor.
description.or: ଏହା virtual power switch। ପ୍ରକୃତ power check ଶିକ୍ଷକ କରିବେ।

description.en: Set the message source to 1000 Hz.
Set the carrier source to 82500 Hz.
Reduce the residual carrier; the virtual dial uses a normalised coefficient.
Stabilise the display; this does not alter the source signal.
description.or: display ସ୍ଥିର କରନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା source signal ବଦଳାଏ ନାହିଁ।

description.en: Measurement instrument supporting the trainer experiment.
Compare the message, modulated and recovered waveforms.
description.or: message, modulated ଓ recovered waveform ତୁଳନା କରନ୍ତୁ।

explanation.en: Frequency counts cycles per second. Period T = 1/f. Peak amplitude and peak-to-peak amplitude are different measurements. CRO settings change the display, not the source.
explanation.or: Frequency ହେଉଛି ପ୍ରତି second ରେ cycle ସଂଖ୍ୟା। T = 1/f। Peak ଓ peak-to-peak amplitude ଅଲଗା। CRO setting source signal ବଦଳାଏ ନାହିଁ।

questions.prompt: What is the unit of frequency?
What is the period of a 1 kHz signal?
A centred sine has 1 V peak. What is its peak-to-peak amplitude?
Changing CRO time/div changes what?
Which signal has more cycles per second?

explanation.en: The message carries the information. The carrier supplies a higher-frequency reference for modulation. Trace each source to its designated input.
explanation.or: Message ରେ ସୂଚନା ଥାଏ। Carrier ର frequency ଅଧିକ। ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ source କୁ ଠିକ input ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

questions.prompt: Which signal represents the information?
Where should the AF output go?
Which source supplies the carrier in this pack?
What does a patch cord do here?
Removing the message should remove which ideal output?

explanation.en: A balanced modulator multiplies message and carrier. For sinusoidal inputs the product has sidebands at fc - fm and fc + fm. Null adjustment reduces carrier leakage; a time trace alone does not prove complete suppression.
explanation.or: Balanced modulator message ଓ carrier କୁ multiply କରେ। Sideband frequency ହେଉଛି fc - fm ଓ fc + fm। Null adjustment carrier leakage କମାଏ।

questions.prompt: What does SC stand for?
Which operation models ideal DSB-SC generation?
For fc = 82.5 kHz and fm = 1 kHz, where are the sidebands?
What is null adjustment used for?
Does an attractive CRO trace prove zero carrier leakage?

options.b: No; appropriate spectral or other validated evidence is needed

explanation.en: A synchronous detector multiplies DSB-SC by a coherent reference. Low-pass filtering retains the message term. With unit carrier amplitudes and unity recovery gain, the ideal output peak is half the input message peak.
explanation.or: Synchronous detector ପାଇଁ coherent reference ଦରକାର। Low-pass filter message ଅଂଶ ରଖେ। ଏହି ideal model ରେ output peak, message peak ର ଅଧା।

questions.prompt: What extra input does synchronous detection need?
Which section removes the high-frequency product?
Which receiver output frequency is expected here?
Can a simple envelope detector generally recover DSB-SC correctly?

options.b: No; coherent detection is required in this experiment

questions.prompt: For a 1 V peak message in this ideal unity-gain receiver, what is the recovered peak?

explanation.en: Follow the instructor-approved supply and common-reference procedure. Stabilise the display before reading frequency and amplitude, retain units, and compare recovered frequency with message frequency. Virtual readings do not count as physical observations.
explanation.or: ଶିକ୍ଷକଙ୍କ supply ଓ connection ନିୟମ ମାନନ୍ତୁ। ସ୍ଥିର display ରୁ frequency ଓ amplitude ପଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ। Virtual reading ପ୍ରକୃତ lab observation ନୁହେଁ।

questions.prompt: Who approves physical power-on checks?
Which values should be compared after detection?
A moving display should first prompt what check?
How should amplitude be recorded?

options.c: With units and peak or peak-to-peak convention

instruction.or: balanced-modulator output ବାଛନ୍ତୁ।

why.en: Locate the output before wiring.

instruction.en: Enable virtual trainer power.
instruction.or: virtual trainer power ଚାଲୁ କରନ୍ତୁ।

why.en: This enables the teaching model; it is not physical power-on approval.
why.or: ଏହି ପଦକ୍ଷେପର କାରଣ ବୁଝି ଆଗକୁ ବଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

instruction.en: Set the AF message to 1000 Hz.
instruction.or: AF message କୁ 1000 Hz କରନ୍ତୁ।

why.en: Use the message frequency specified by the source procedure.
why.or: ଏହି ପଦକ୍ଷେପର କାରଣ ବୁଝି ଆଗକୁ ବଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

instruction.en: Set the RF carrier to 82500 Hz.
instruction.or: RF carrier କୁ 82500 Hz କରନ୍ତୁ।

why.en: Keep the message and carrier sources distinct.
why.or: ଏହି ପଦକ୍ଷେପର କାରଣ ବୁଝି ଆଗକୁ ବଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

instruction.en: Connect Message output to Message input.
instruction.or: Message output କୁ Message input ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

why.en: Route information to the balanced modulator.
why.or: ଏହି ପଦକ୍ଷେପର କାରଣ ବୁଝି ଆଗକୁ ବଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

instruction.en: Connect Carrier output to Carrier input.
instruction.or: Carrier output କୁ Carrier input ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

why.en: The carrier is multiplied by the message.
why.or: ଏହି ପଦକ୍ଷେପର କାରଣ ବୁଝି ଆଗକୁ ବଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

instruction.en: Connect DSB-SC output to the CRO input.
instruction.or: DSB-SC output କୁ CRO input ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

why.en: Inspect the transmitter output at the specified test point.
why.or: ଏହି ପଦକ୍ଷେପର କାରଣ ବୁଝି ଆଗକୁ ବଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

instruction.en: Choose auto trigger for a stable virtual display.
instruction.or: ସ୍ଥିର virtual display ପାଇଁ auto trigger ବାଛନ୍ତୁ।

why.en: Display stability supports reliable reading.
why.or: ଏହି ପଦକ୍ଷେପର କାରଣ ବୁଝି ଆଗକୁ ବଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

instruction.en: Reduce the normalised virtual residual-carrier coefficient to zero.
instruction.or: virtual residual-carrier coefficient କୁ zero କରନ୍ତୁ।

why.en: This represents balancing the modulator, not a calibrated hardware dial value.
why.or: ଏହି ପଦକ୍ଷେପର କାରଣ ବୁଝି ଆଗକୁ ବଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

instruction.en: Connect DSB-SC output to Detector signal input.
instruction.or: DSB-SC output କୁ Detector signal input ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

why.en: Route the transmitted signal to synchronous detection.
why.or: ଏହି ପଦକ୍ଷେପର କାରଣ ବୁଝି ଆଗକୁ ବଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

instruction.en: Connect Carrier output to Detector reference input.
instruction.or: Carrier output କୁ Detector reference input ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

why.en: A shared reference provides ideal coherent recovery.
why.or: ଏହି ପଦକ୍ଷେପର କାରଣ ବୁଝି ଆଗକୁ ବଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

instruction.en: Move the virtual CRO probe to Recovered output.
instruction.or: virtual CRO probe କୁ Recovered output ରେ ଯୋଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

why.en: Compare the recovered output with the original message.
why.or: ଏହି ପଦକ୍ଷେପର କାରଣ ବୁଝି ଆଗକୁ ବଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

instruction.en: Measure the recovered frequency in Hz.
instruction.or: recovered frequency କୁ Hz ରେ ମାପନ୍ତୁ।

why.en: Recovery should return the original message frequency.
why.or: ଏହି ପଦକ୍ଷେପର କାରଣ ବୁଝି ଆଗକୁ ବଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

instruction.en: Measure recovered peak amplitude in V in the ideal model.
instruction.or: ideal model ର recovered peak amplitude କୁ V ରେ ମାପନ୍ତୁ।

why.en: The normalised model has unity recovery gain; hardware amplitude must be measured separately.
why.or: ଏହି ପଦକ୍ଷେପର କାରଣ ବୁଝି ଆଗକୁ ବଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ।
